verdict.rationale: The Paxos Payments docs cover the whole story. Merchants can accept PYUSD, USDC and USDP on-chain, "automatically convert the stablecoin to fiat" instead of holding stablecoin balances, and "settle USD directly to your bank account." A redeem orchestration (convert stablecoins to USD and withdraw to bank in one call) and the Fiat Transfers API (Fedwire, SWIFT, CUBIX) back up the payout path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the auto-conversion settlement flow.
